blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines is not moving fast enough to strengthen its defenses, Defense Sec. Gilberto Teodoro Jr. warned on Saturday. Teodoro said ambitious national security plans should have been laid out years ago. “When national security is concerned, ambitious plans needed to have been laid down on the ground years ago. But we cannot recoup the past. We can only make the present faster,” he said in his remarks at the Philippine Military Academy’s (PMA) 128th founding anniversary in Baguio City. “And today is not fast enough.
